name: Stan Kroenke

views.text: Build the stadium yourself and you control the future of the franchise.
I let my football people run football.
Winning speaks louder than anything I could say.
Trading picks for stars is fine when it brings a title.
A long-term vision outlasts a bad season.
Los Angeles is a market you earn with championships.

signatures: lets executives speak for the club

motivation.want: a lasting legacy in Los Angeles anchored by the stadium and titles
motivation.fear: investing billions without the team staying a contender

voice: Almost silent in public; when he speaks it is short, guarded and about long-term vision. Lets results and his executives talk.

evidence.summary: Profile of Kroenke opening his privately financed, roughly $5.5 billion SoFi Stadium; notes the "Silent Stan" nickname for rarely speaking or celebrating in public.
AP on SoFi Stadium's opening, built by Kroenke without government financing; executives such as COO Kevin Demoff speak for the club.
